Product description

Tactical backpack

  • Reliable and durable material: 18.5 x 11.5 x 7.5 inches, capacity: 25L . 19.5 x 12.5 x 8.5 inches, capacity: 26L.The backpack is made of 900D high-density fabric, which is durable.
  • MOLLE system: the entire MOLLE webbing is used to attach tactical bags or equipment
  • Comfortable and practical: heavy zipper and practical pull rope, load compression system on both sides, Velcro bracket, breathable mesh cushion shoulder strap, breathable and comfortable.

Tactical backpack

Product size is 18.5 x 11.5 x 7.5 inches. capacity: 25L . 19.5 x 12.5 x 8.5 inches, capacity: 26L.The shock bag backpack is designed with double needle heavy zipper and practical pull cord, side and front load compression system, and the shoulder belt is made of breathable mesh cushion, which is breathable and comfortable. The military backpack has hydration compatibility. It can be used as a hydrated backpack or an outdoor camping hiking backpack. It is very suitable for a hydrated bladder. This tactical bag backpack can be used as a 3-day bag, army backpack, range backpack, hunting backpack, survival backpack, hiking backpack and daily backpack. Note: this military backpack does not include a hydrating bladder.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Customers say

Customers find this tactical backpack to be of excellent quality, with well-designed pockets and strong zippers that work smoothly. School, travel or work. This is the bag you need.
This is honestly the best backpack I have bought myself. Has various compartments for storage. It is the perfect size for school or just occasional use including if you needed to take a backpack to an airport this is just what you need. It’s not too big or baggy. It is a very firm backpack. It even maintains its shape when you set it down unlike backpacks, which slouch. For reference I put a 33.8 ounce bottle water in one of the side pockets. And the American patch can be removed. It’s just Velcro. This is a great purchase that I highly recommend.

    I tried 7 different backpacks for my bicycle and my back so you wouldn't have to!
    Reviewed in the United States on April 16, 2026
    Color: BlackSize: 18.5 inch
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I tired several different backpacks at once, and this one won in the size, quality and sturdiness of material, and ability to pack everything I want on my back and on my E-bike luggage rack. Talk about versatile! (Yes, versatility was an Amazon prompt.) You probably wouldn't believe what all I have in this thing, but it's a very good survival pack-out. A couple of hints would be AR500 and Sub.. shelter, water storage & Sawyer purification, fire, blades, cooking, rain jacket, several hundred calories of food, 30 aspartame-free drink singles. The straps are a great length for me and they tuck well for strapping to my bicycle. I like the pack tight to my back, and the sternum strap is ideal for holding it centered where I want it. The zippers and nearly everything about this screams tactical. The only thing that I find odd that doesn't seem tactical is the soft inside material and the pattern. I highly recommend this pack above all. It was the perfect fit for my need of a bicycle luggage carrier that I can also carry on my back. The bike and everything on the backpack was purchased from Amazon and I comes highly recommended! The water bottles and the carabiner paracord lanyards were separate purchases. The lanyards are 6" total length and center the pack on the luggage rack. I am confident that this pack holds everything I need if I had to rough it for a night or 2.

About this Item

  • Reliable and durable materials. Tactical Backpack Size 18.5 x 11.5 x 7.5 inches, capacity: 25L; military backpack made of 900D high-density fabric for durability.
  • Our Wotony Tactical Backpack is the perfect military-styled backpack for men who need high-quality and durable backpacks. MOLLE system: the entire MOLLE webbing is used to attach tactical bags or equipment
  • Comfortable and practical: tactical molle backpack heavy-duty zipper and practical drawstring, load compression system on both sides, Velcro brace, breathable mesh padded shoulder straps, breathable and comfortable.
  • Ensure versatility: This military assault backpack is absolutely a must-have for every regular camping, hiking, hiking, travel or outdoor survival adventure enthusiast! It is compact and portable.
  • Plenty of storage space and pockets: This tactical backpack is the best complement to your adventure. It has many compartments that provide excellent storage capacity and organization without slowing you down.

Product Description

Tactical Backpack army backpack Product size is 18.5 x 11.5 x 7.5 inches. The Tactical Backpack backpack is designed with double needle heavy zipper and practical pull cord, side and front load compression system, and the shoulder belt is made of breathable mesh cushion, which is breathable and comfortable. The military backpack has hydration compatibility. It can be used as a hydrated backpack or an outdoor camping hiking backpack. It is very suitable for a hydrated bladder. This tactical assault bag backpack can be used as a 3-day assault bag, army backpack, range backpack, hunting backpack, survival backpack, hiking backpack and daily backpack. Note: this military backpack does not include a hydrating bladder.Our Wotony Tactical Backpack is the perfect military-styled backpack for men who need high-quality and durable backpacks.
